verdict.rationale: The evidence documents llmster, a headless daemon for servers, cloud instances and CI, but nothing about running LM Studio inside a container. There is no Docker image, container guide or reproducible-deployment documentation. A headless mode is an adjacent capability that could make containerization possible, but it is not the containerized-runtime capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the runtime inside a container for reproducible deployment
